inputs.text: [curious] SHOH… nih… SOR… us. [pauses] Two pieces in this name. "Shoni" is a place: the Shoshone Mountains, [serious] in the Nevada desert, in the United States.
[warmly] The whole name, yes. He lived two hundred thirty million years ago, [amazed] long before most dinosaurs — [pauses] and that desert, back then, was a whole sea.
